judgment_rule: helpful/harmful/neutral/uncertain by offline reading; one high-confidence helpful+harmful pair per state; skip when no high-confidence harmful

selection.criterion: state had four complete qwen sft-pruned-v1-ep1 candidates plus one DS historical reflection answer

format.dpo.jsonl: TRL conversational preference format: prompt = verbatim system+user messages; chosen/rejected = [{'role':'assistant','content': <verbatim text>}]
format.labels: A-E were anonymised during review; label->source mapping is in pair_manifest.jsonl
format.no_split: No train/validation/test split is assigned. States are independent reflection snapshots of the same benchmark cases; split by case family downstream if needed.
format.provenance_caveat: DS answers were produced on reconstructed stage inputs (input_reconstructed=true in source pipeline); qwen answers are direct generations on the same frozen prompt. target text is response.final_text only (no thinking).
